# RxCredentialing.com

> RxCredentialing provides comprehensive medical billing, credentialing, and revenue cycle management services for healthcare practices of all sizes.

RxCredentialing.com specializes in affordable, HIPAA-compliant medical billing and practice management solutions including physician credentialing, insurance verification, denial management, and virtual assistant services across multiple medical specialties. The platform serves independent practices, small clinics, and specialty-focused healthcare providers with integrated EHR/EMR solutions and EDI/ERA/EFT processing capabilities.

## Key Topics

- Revenue Cycle Management (RCM)
- Medical Billing Services
- Insurance Credentialing
- HIPAA Compliance
- Denial Management
- EDI/ERA/EFT Processing
- CPT Coding
- Claims Processing
- Eligibility Verification
- EHR/EMR Integration
- CAQH
- NPI Registration
- Medicaid/Medicare
- Practice Management
- Accounts Receivable Recovery

## Core Services

- [Affordable Medical Billing & Practice Management Services](https://rxcredentialing.com): RxCredentialing homepage showcasing medical billing, credentialing, and RCM services.
- [Physician Billing Services - RxCredentialing.com](https://rxcredentialing.com/physician-billing-services): Core service page for physician billing with EHR/EMR integration and denial management.
- [Insurance Credentialing Service for Physicians](https://rxcredentialing.com/insurance-credentialing-service): Insurance credentialing for physicians, PAs, NPs covering Medicare, Medicaid, and CAQH.
- [Medical Licensing Services for MD, RN, PA, DO](https://rxcredentialing.com/medical-licensing-services): Medical licensing services for MD, RN, PA, DO with FSMB compliance and free consultation.
- [Verification of Benefits Services for Healthcare Providers](https://rxcredentialing.com/insurance-eligibility-verification-services-for-private-practice): Verification of Benefits and insurance eligibility services with prior authorization support.
- [Virtual Medical Assistant Services for Healthcare](https://rxcredentialing.com/virtual-medical-assistant-services-for-healthcare): HIPAA-compliant virtual medical assistant services starting at $799 for healthcare practices.

## Specialty Billing Services

- [Internal Medicine Billing Services](https://rxcredentialing.com/internal-medicine-billing-services): Specialty-specific internal medicine billing with E/M coding, CCM, and RPM expertise.
- [Cardiology Billing Service](https://rxcredentialing.com/cardiology-billing-service): Cardiology-specific billing service with CPT coding and denial management expertise.
- [Gastroenterology Billing Services](https://rxcredentialing.com/gastroenterology-billing-services): GI billing for scopes, injections, procedures with EDI/ERA/EFT integration.
- [Ob/Gyn Billing Services](https://rxcredentialing.com/ob-gyn-billing-services): OB/GYN billing services with 94% clean claim rates for women's health practices.
- [Pediatric Billing Services](https://rxcredentialing.com/pediatric-billing-services): Pediatric billing services with vaccine billing and Medicaid MCO claim management.
- [Neurology Billing Services](https://rxcredentialing.com/neurology-billing-services): Neurology billing optimizing EEG, EMG, cognitive testing reimbursements with HIPAA compliance.
- [Mental Health Billing Services](https://rxcredentialing.com/mental-health-billing-services): Behavioral health billing reducing denials 50% with therapy and psychiatry expertise.
- [Physical Therapy Billing Services](https://rxcredentialing.com/medical-billing-for-physical-therapy): Physical therapy billing from $499/month with 8-Minute Rule and modifier expertise.
- [Podiatry Medical Billing Services](https://rxcredentialing.com/podiatry-medical-billing-services): Podiatry billing services with authorization tracking and eligibility verification.
